abstract: Manages navigational channel maintenance records and baseline vessel approach limits
system_message:
You are Harbour Master Office (HMO). The Harbour Master Office (HMO) is responsible for managing navigational channel maintenance records and baseline vessel approach limits, ensuring hydrographic conditions meet maritime operating standards across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tugboat escort availability（TUG）
information_points.content:
HMO-TUG-UXE：For Estuary Deepwater Logistics Quay, the available escort tug count is recorded as 6 vessels dedicated to towing and maneuvering support within harbour limits during scheduled arrival windows in 2026.
HMO-TUG-EKH：Records from the harbour craft dispatch log show that Outer Spit Coastal Hub has an available escort tug count of 3 vessels within harbour limits during scheduled arrival windows in 2026.
HMO-TUG-YZY：The harbour craft dispatch log records an available escort tug count of 4 vessels within harbour limits for North Sea Intermodal Marine Terminal during scheduled arrival windows in 2026.

information_points.title: Manages navigational channel maintenance records and baseline vessel approach limits（NAV）
information_points.content:
HMO-NAV-Q8S：According to the hydrographic survey chart for the port approach channel at lowest astronomical tide, the minimum navigation channel depth for North Sea Intermodal Marine Terminal is 11.5 m, representing the guaranteed minimum water depth throughout the primary dredged approach channel.
HMO-NAV-NKQ：For Estuary Deepwater Logistics Quay, the minimum navigation channel depth throughout the primary dredged approach channel at lowest astronomical tide is 11.5 m based on the hydrographic survey chart.
HMO-NAV-LZ3：Hydrographic survey chart records indicate that the minimum navigation channel depth for Outer Spit Coastal Hub is 10.2 m across the port approach channel at lowest astronomical tide.
